svg.title: CEE 7/3 Schuko socket-outlet (female), mating face
svg.desc: Schematic front view of the circular recess. Two pin holes on a horizontal line, line or neutral on either side (unpolarised). Two earthing clips on the recess wall at 12 and 6 o'clock. Rings are contact tubes (female contacts); bars are sexless earthing clips. Proportions follow 19 mm between pin holes and 16 mm from the centre to each clip.
